messages:
maya: heads up — our sampleapp rerank endpoint is failing on customer onboarding flow. getting `vector dim mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024` when we call /v1/rerank
maya: repro steps: node sampleapp -> fetch embeddings via sdk.batchEmbeddings -> call rerank with those vectors -> crash
maya: looks like the node SDK helper is returning 1024-d vectors by default for the model alias 'open-embed-lite' but our rerank expects 1536
sam: @maya can you paste the exact payload you're sending to rerank? also which SDK version?
maya: node sdk v0.8.2. payload snippet:
```
{
  query: "How to configure batching?",
  candidates: [ {id: 1, text: "...", embedding: [0.12, 0.03, ...] }, ... ]
}
```
maya: the candidate embedding arrays are length 1024
jonathan: hmm, python sampleapp (sdk v1.2.0) returns 1536 for the same model alias, so looks like a parity issue between SDKs
jonathan: node helper `batchEmbeddings()` has an optimization that quantizes/variants to a smaller dim for speed if `compatFallback: true` is set — not obvious in README :/
elaine: also seeing auth flakiness in the logs — a 401 triggers the client retry which replays the rerank call and causes double-scoring. rerank endpoint isn't idempotent in our integration so that causes bad UX for the customer
elaine: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T14:03:22Z] 401 Unauthorized - token expired
[2026-03-15T14:03:22Z] client retry -> re-sent rerank (non-idempotent)
[2026-03-15T14:03:22Z] 200 OK
```
sam: ok two separate problems: (1) SDK parity/batching helper altering embedding dim, (2) retry/auth flow causing duplicate side-effects. we should fix both but quick mitigations first
sam: quick workaround for maya: explicitly request embedding model variant and normalize dims before rerank. e.g. set `model: 'open-embed-1536'` and run a pad/trim step in the client:
```
function normalize(vec, targetDim){
  if(vec.length > targetDim) return vec.slice(0, targetDim)
  while(vec.length < targetDim) vec.push(0)
  return vec
}
```
maya: works locally with that patch, thanks. will ship to staging
jonathan: I'll open PR in node SDK to remove that implicit dimension-reduction optimization and add a clear option `reduce_dim: false` with unit tests. also will add a note to migration guide
elaine: for the retry issue — change retry logic to not replay non-idempotent endpoints automatically. we should mark rerank as non-idempotent in the SDK endpoint config and require explicit client opt-in to retry on 401 for those calls
elaine: short-term fix: set SDK to do auth-refresh-before-retry: true (refresh token flow then reattempt only once). I'll add a patch in the sampleapp config
maya: will verify staging after both fixes. also found a response-format quirk: python SDK returns embedding as `embedding: [..]` while node returns `embeddings: [{vector:[..]}]` in some codepaths — that broke our rerank parser
sam: argh. that's a parsing bug. we need to normalize server response in the SDK to a single canonical shape: `{embedding: number[]}` for single-item calls and `{embeddings: number[][]}` for batch calls. I'll file issue and own canonicalization
ci-bot: deploy-bot: staging build queued for sampleapp with patch refs/heads/fix/embed-dim-1536 (build 482)
maya: thanks everyone. action items:
- jonathan: PR to remove implicit dim reduction + add config + tests
- sam: canonicalize response shape across SDKs + update docs
- elaine: change retry policy for non-idempotent endpoints, add auth-refresh-before-retry flag
- maya: validate staging run and paste repro logs here

maya: quick note — customer onboarding blocked, tagging support: @support to let them know we have a workaround and ETA for SDK fixes :thumbsup:
